jei.advancedrocketrycommunity.rocket_sat: Holds one satellite package owned by the bay's owner. Hoppers and droppers can insert and extract it, except while a rocket assembly or disassembly holds the bay. In a flying rocket the package is locked. Deployment in orbit is not available in this version. Breaking or blowing up the bay drops the bay and its package once each.
jei.advancedrocketrycommunity.solar_arra: Horizontal layout: 3 wide, 22 deep. Front row: output plug, controller, output plug. With the controller facing you, the 63 cells behind it accept array panels, air or machine casing; at least one panel is required. The controller UP face must be exposed to sky or space. Surfaces generate only in daytime; rain and thunder reduce output. Stations use committed orbit-body sunlight; a missing orbit explicitly shows Space fallback. Uses the shared solar enable switch and multiplier. Buffer: 20,000 FE. Both plugs share 1,000 FE/t output. Ordinary breaking destroys stored FE.
